stem: The reader can conclude that Junior Achievement, Girl Scouts, and Boy Scouts all share which belief?

options.label: A
options.text: Every child should have the opportunity to attend summer camp.

options.label: B
options.text: Students of all ages are capable of owning their own businesses.

options.label: C
options.text: Many people buy more things than they can afford.

options.label: D
options.text: Managing a personal budget is a necessary skill.
